rules.plates: 864x1080 WebP q80 <= 150 KB, generated 704x880 then lanczos up (Your Call art3 pipeline), daylight only, mean relative luminance >= 0.55, no people and nothing that moves
rules.cutouts: WebP with alpha <= 30 KB, width = round(box.w% x 864) at the size below, cut with FEschool/social/tools/segment/cut.mjs; a state pair counts as 2
rules.portraits: half-body cut-outs, 600 px tall, expressions calm / warm / oh; no hands are drawn anywhere (objects move under the finger)
rules.text: no text baked into any art: labels, numbers, the recipe and the note are live HTML
rules.dropIn: save as games/cozy-chores/art/<id>.webp in both apps, then run Claude/specs/games-expansion-2026-10-22/cozy-chores-tools/build-manifest.mjs (sets ready:true)
